contracts.initial: max = selected form HP(level) + fixed HP Fou1000 + explicit CE HP(level,LB); seed = 0 when permille0, otherwise max(1,floor(max*permille/1000)). Missing or contradictory initial data is invalid, never zero.
contracts.queries: Buff conditions/value expressions use trunc((current/max)*1000), NP coefficient uses current/max directly, display rounds percent. All read the current actor state at their ordered clock. Integer-only HP observations cannot substitute for continuous ratios away from the exact zero/full endpoints. Lowest-HP selection requests an initial maximum when needed, then replays. NP ratio has no integer-permille fallback.
contracts.healing: Fixed amount or max*(0.001*Value), then *(0.001*receive)*(0.001*give), truncate once, clamp to max. Receive/give limits come from canonical buff actions. No revival; noHealing blocks actual gain.
contracts.loss: Fixed or percentage of current maximum, truncate once. Ordinary floor0, safe floor1 only if already alive. Turn-end drain/regeneration and their conversion/modifiers are outside this pre-NP damage scope.
contracts.maximum: base + fixed max/base modifiers + trunc(0.001*(maxRate+baseRate)*base), minimum1. Grant adjusts living current by the raw granted contribution then clamps. Max modifier removal preserves current then clamps; positive baseHP removal subtracts its contribution (minimum1). Form base changes before old passives are removed and new passives applied.
contracts.transfer: Input is initial current donor HP (0=dead/absent). Gain=sum(min(max(snapshot-1,0),child cost)); receiver actual gain clamps independently. Receive/give modifiers do not affect transfer. Unresisted safe child loss is applied even when receiver gains0. Later transfers read remaining donor HP, never reseed.
contracts.unknown: Unknown metadata, aliases, child probabilities/resistance, unreadable state and unresolved writers fail closed. A missing maximum after a writer is repaired by an initial maximum and complete replay, never by overwriting a post-write ratio.
contracts.transaction: HP/NP/OC/context, effect commitment and all receipts roll back together on command rejection. Initial and terminal HP0 cannot attack; positive HP with displayed0% can.
contracts.admission: HP writers are joined to ordered HP readers independently of NP gain/capacity. Damage expressions and conditions read terminal HP; preparation readers retain order and physical actor identity. Terminal normal loss keeps maximum/healing prerequisites. The common executor validates each candidate.
contracts.sourceMaximumInput: A single canonical definition is shared by HP mutation, lowest-HP recipient selection, and OC HP readers; repairing it cannot conflict by differing labels/descriptions.
